title: Bar Drop Glacier Mint 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Glacier Mint by Drop is a cooler, sweeter alternative to standard mint blends. It focuses on the taste of spearmint, offering a sweet and mellow profile similar to chewing gum. This is underpinned by a profound icy note that provides a lasting cooling sensation, living up to its glacial name. Formulated with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this blend delivers a sharp, clean taste where the sweetness of the spearmint cuts clearly through the cold finish. Optimised for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, the nicotine salt base offers a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
